lessons.title: Evidentiality and the Subjunctive
lessons.learn: Calibrate certainty by distinguishing reported fact, inference, and evaluation.

grammar.title: Mood after stance expressions
grammar.explain: Indicative mood presents information as asserted; the subjunctive after no parece que, es posible que, and evaluative frames suspends or evaluates commitment. The choice is semantic, not decorative.

lessons.title: Cohesion, Reference, and Reported Discourse
lessons.learn: Build extended arguments whose references, reported voices, concessions, and consequences remain unambiguous.

grammar.title: Cohesive reference and sequence
grammar.explain: C1 discourse uses lexical reference, demonstratives, and reported speech to avoid both mechanical repetition and vague pronouns. Connectors must encode a real relation between propositions.

lessons.title: Professional Diplomacy and Mitigated Requests
lessons.learn: Negotiate deadlines, disagreement, and responsibility without obscuring the requested action.

grammar.title: Conditional mitigation
grammar.explain: The conditional and imperfect subjunctive can soften proposals and requests. Mitigation protects rapport, but an effective professional message still names the action, actor, and deadline.

examples.t: Le agradecería que enviara la versión revisada antes del jueves.

examples.t: Sería conveniente dejar constancia de la discrepancia en el acta.
examples.r: seria konvenyente dejar konstansia de la diskrepansia en el akta
examples.en: It would be advisable to record the disagreement in the minutes.

examples.t: Podríamos aceptar la contrapropuesta siempre que se mantuviera el plazo.
examples.r: podriamos aseptar la kontrapropuesta syempre ke se mantuvyera el plaso

lessons.title: Academic Definition and Qualified Comparison
lessons.learn: Define analytical terms, compare equivalent evidence, and preserve scope in reformulation.

grammar.title: Qualification and nominalisation
grammar.explain: Academic Spanish often packages processes as nouns, but nominalisation must not hide the agent or inflate certainty. A comparison states population, criterion, and limitation.

examples.r: la konklusion se limita a la muestra urbana estudyada

examples.t: La correlación observada no demuestra por sí sola causalidad.

examples.t: En otras palabras, aumentó el promedio, no cada uno de los valores.

examples.en: In other words, the average increased, not every value.

lessons.title: Regional Variation and Contextual Register
lessons.learn: Interpret regional forms and colloquial choices without treating one variety as defective or universally appropriate.

grammar.title: Sociolinguistic choice
grammar.explain: Pronouns, address, vocabulary, and discourse markers vary across Spanish-speaking regions. Label the source region and relationship; teach comprehension broadly while selecting a consistent production norm.

lessons.title: Source Synthesis and Public Mediation
lessons.learn: Synthesize conflicting sources and explain technical conclusions to a non-specialist audience without distorting certainty.

grammar.title: Concession and mediation
grammar.explain: A synthesis relates sources rather than listing them. Public mediation retains the proposition and evidence limits while changing density, terminology, and examples for the audience.
grammar.pattern: source A + relation to source B + warranted synthesis

examples.t: Ambos estudios convergen en la dirección del efecto, aunque discrepan sobre su magnitud.
examples.r: ambos estudyos konverhen en la direksion del efekto aunke diskrepan sobre su magnitud
examples.en: Both studies converge on the direction of the effect, although they disagree on its magnitude.

examples.t: La síntesis debe conservar las salvedades metodológicas de cada fuente.
examples.r: la sintesis debe konserva las salvedades metodolohikas de kada fuente
examples.en: The synthesis must preserve each source’s methodological caveats.

examples.t: Para el público general, reformularemos el hallazgo sin presentarlo como certeza.
examples.r: para el publiko heneral reformularemos el ayasgo sin presentarlo komo sertesa
examples.en: For the general public, we will reformulate the finding without presenting it as certainty.

mistakes: Preserve mood, stance, cohesion, and register; a grammatically possible form may still be pragmatically inappropriate.
